correctness.rationale: Exact all-size proof: the zero-sum distance-power form is equation (1); within-blade Cauchy and a weighted rank-one criterion are sharp both ways. The crossing function is strictly increasing; equality is one-dimensional, and strict concavity characterizes global size-partition extremizers. The standalone checker passed 2,565 supplementary exact or finite-partition tests. No finite computation is used to establish the infinite theorem.
